title: ci: delete the spec-main-shape-gate copy, the spec shape gate runs in objectstack (objectui#12352)
body:
Fixes #12352
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23238 (comment 6145029395, batch 336 item 3, maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-10-13), the objectui half: "the spec shape gate moves to objectstack … objectui drops its copy" once the objectstack side agrees for two consecutive hourly runs. The objectstack half landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23283 (`18cd410dc4`); the card shows four agreeing pairs.

## The successor

- **The gate:** objectstack's `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml` (`Spec Shape Gate`), hourly on objectstack `main` at `:52`. It clones objectui `main`, injects the spec built from the objectstack commit with objectstack's own `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs inject`, and runs this repository's `TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm type-check --continue`. It is registered in objectstack's `RELEASE_GATE_WORKFLOWS` (`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs`), so its scheduled run is read by the release gate, and a red is attributed to the objectstack lane that moved the shape.
- **Intentional retirements** are registered from now on in objectstack's `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`, one entry per retirement naming the objectui card that removes the downstream use; the gate reads a matching diagnostic as known, not new.
- The successor calls none of the files deleted here: its `inject` and `report` are objectstack's own port (read on objectstack `origin/main` at `6362c66ca`).

## What changed

| Path | Change | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml` | deleted | the copy the ruling drops |
| `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` | deleted | its script; no other file imports it |
| `scripts/__tests__/spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts` | deleted | its pin test |
| `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` | `NOT_A_GATE` entry and the `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` note removed | no workflow produces the context any more; the partition test (`the gate names checks that no pull-request workflow produces`) refuses a classified name nothing produces, and the note said "the reason is written there" about the entry being removed |
| `scripts/__tests__/dependabot-merge-gate.test.ts` | the objectui#12240 describe block removed | it pinned the `NOT_A_GATE` entry above; the general partition test now holds the absence |
| `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` | `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` tombstone rewritten | it pointed at the deleted workflow's header and described re-enrolment; it now says the workflow is gone and the name must not come back to the ruleset (a required context nothing reports stalls the queue at the ruleset timeout, objectui#3523) |
| `.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml` | header comment only | it said the gate "keeps its own workflow for its hourly run on `main`" |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | inventory row removed; Repo Gates paragraph updated; the `Spec Main Shape Gate` section replaced by a short `Spec Shape Gate — moved to objectstack` section | the page's pins require every bare workflow filename it names to exist; the new section names the successor, the registry, and why `turbo.json` keeps the marker |
| `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` | the two `SWEEP_DECLARED_NON_RUN_COMMANDS` entries keyed on the deleted workflow removed | the map is asserted as an exact set; with no section, both entries would read as stale |

## Kept on purpose

- **`turbo.json` `globalDependencies` keeps `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/.spec-main-shape-gate.json`.** Who writes the marker: before this change, objectui's `inject` and objectstack's `inject`; after it, objectstack's `inject` still writes the same-named marker into every spec copy it replaces in an objectui install (`MARKER_FILE` in objectstack's `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs`, whose header says the spelling "stays objectui's … for as long as objectui's turbo config names it"). Who reads it: turbo, through this entry, and nothing else in this tree (`git grep` for the marker name outside the deleted files hits only `turbo.json`; `scripts/select-type-check-scope.mjs` reads `globalDependencies` generically as root-change globs). The function still holds: a local reproduction of the successor gate in a linked worktree shares `.turbo/cache` with its siblings, and the marker keeps a forced injected run from leaving a verdict an installed tree replays (objectui#12114). Removing it would leave objectstack's header describing a coupling that no longer exists. Its in-tree pin lived in the deleted test, so the entry is now unpinned here; the new docs section carries the reason.
- **`scripts/__tests__/select-type-check-scope.test.ts`** still feeds the two deleted paths as input strings to the selector: that case reproduces PR #12262's diff, turbo's answer is stubbed to an empty list, and nothing reads those paths from disk. The case stays true.
- **`scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts` and `fixtures/required-check-set/live-2026-10-12.json`** are a dated reading of the objectui#12240 window and a pin that the name is neither pinned nor watched; both stay true. The seven ruled names are unchanged.
- **The objectui#12240 window paragraph in the `check-required-check-set.mjs` header** is history and stays true.
- **`packages/**`, `CHANGELOG.md` and landed `.changeset/*` mentions** are other lanes' history and are not touched (listed in the report).

## Safety readings (2026-10-16, before the first push)

- **Live ruleset:** `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main`, evaluated by `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs --fixture` on the saved answer: `INTACT`, seven required contexts, `Spec Main Shape Gate` not among them. So deleting the workflow cannot leave a required context unreported. (The script's own live read answered 401 in this container for want of a token, exit 2, a reading not taken; the same endpoint read through `gh api` answered.)
- **Agreement, re-read at start:** the last four `schedule` runs on `main` of both gates all concluded `success` (objectui `38833480846`, `38826070331`, `38819949451`, `38813070302`; objectstack `38833492264`, `38826210209`, `38820098793`, `38813219037`). objectui#12325 is closed.

## Changeset

None. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` on this diff: "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed" (exit 0). The diff touches workflows, scripts and docs only.

## Governed surface

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on all nine changed paths: `GOVERNED`, 2 of 9 paths on `.github/workflows/**` (exit 3). This PR stays a draft; it is a dispatched PR, so the claiming seat requests the review and lands it after an authorised approval.

## Verification at `3e9675e20`

`node ../objectstack/scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` refuses by design (the script derives only objectstack's families), so the local set was hand-derived from this repository's own workflows and tests:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 89 test files: every test under `scripts/__tests__/` that names `repo-gates.yml`, the deleted workflow, `dependabot-merge-gate`, `check-required-check-set`, `ci-cd-pipeline.md` or `workflow-checks`, plus every test that reads `.github/workflows/`: `Test Files 89 passed (89)`, `Tests 3340 passed (3340)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` (tsc over `scripts/`, the pin tests included): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four changed script and test files: exit 0.
- The install-free Repo Gates steps, each exit 0: `check-control-bytes`, `check-action-ref-convention`, `check-pre-install-import-graph` (self-test and run), `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages` (self-test and run), `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-component-types`; plus `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-required-check-set --self-test`, `check-changeset-presence`.
- NOT MEASURED locally, CI's: the full `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, the turbo type-check, `Build Docs`, `Build & E2E`, and the Repo Gates steps that need a build (doc snippet and skill example compiles). The new docs section adds no fenced block.

## Acceptance notes

- objectstack's `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` still carries the entry registered to objectui#12325, although that card closed on 2026-10-14 and the file's `$comment` says an entry is "deleted when that card closes". The objectui runs have been green since, so the entry matches nothing today; a later break of the same pattern would read as known. An observation about the objectstack side, not acted on here.
- The `turbo.json` marker entry has no in-tree pin after this change (see "Kept on purpose").
- Several `packages/**` comments describe the gate in the present tense ("compiled … by the Spec Main Shape Gate against `main`"). The compile they describe still happens, now as objectstack's `Spec Shape Gate`; only the name is stale. Other lanes' files, left alone.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 删掉 objectui 自己那份 spec 形状门(workflow、脚本、它的 pin 测试),并把五处提到它的说明改成「门已搬到 objectstack」。
- **为什么改:** 维护者已裁(objectstack-ai/objectstack#23238 裁决 B):形状门搬到上游 objectstack,objectui 的副本在两边连续一致后删除;卡上记了四对一致的小时运行。两份同时在跑只会让人读错哪份是权威。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 线上必需检查名单里已没有这个检查名(本 PR 开出前实读),删掉不会卡住合并队列;后继门在 objectstack 每小时跑、发版前必过,红灯归改动 spec 的那条 lane。回滚 = revert 本 PR,门恢复原样。
- **席位意见:**
- **你要做的:** 看一眼删除范围与保留的 `turbo.json` 标记理由,批准后由认领席落地。
